cases.label: True Positive KA
cases.selection_reason: Representative true-positive example from damage group KA.
cases.interpretation: Actual label: fault (KA); predicted label: abnormal. The reconstruction captures the coarse envelope but leaves a moderate oscillatory mismatch in the finer waveform detail. FFT magnitudes for the original and reconstruction mostly overlap; the remaining residual spectrum is small and is concentrated most in the low-frequency band around 0.050, 0.090, 0.500 cycles/sample. That persistent mismatch against the healthy reconstruction is what likely pushed the anomaly score above threshold.
